findings.label: GSTIN validation is shape-only and client-only
findings.detail: isValidGstin checks the 15-character pattern but not the check digit. The admin settings service has no server-side check for store.gstin. Add the GSTIN checksum to isValidGstin and enforce it in the settings service for store.gstin.

findings.label: Blended-rate drift (out of scope)
findings.detail: Per-line tax drifts about 0.5-1% from rate x taxable (5% line: Rs 76.02 vs Rs 76.48; 18% line: Rs 102.62 vs Rs 103.20) because computeTotals charges one integer-rounded weighted rate across the cart. Track it as a separate pricing-engine fix; pricing.ts must stay untouched here.
